evidence: Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label, modifies generateblock interface and argument handling in src/rpc/mining.cpp, and updates CLI client parsing in src/rpc/client.cpp.
rationale: Extends the generateblock RPC to support multiple coinbase outputs and optional transactions fallback to the mempool. This fills a gap that forced regtest developers simulating mining pool payouts into manual block construction workarounds, following external tester requests.
